summary: Quetta Acquisition Corp, a Nasdaq-listed blank-check company, filed an 8-K on Oct. 8, 2026, disclosing it will convene its previously announced special meeting on Oct. 8 at 4:00 p.m. ET and immediately adjourn it to Oct. 9 at 4:00 p.m. ET to solicit additional proxies for the proposal in its definitive proxy statement. The record date remains Sept. 22, 2026. Prior proxies stay valid unless revoked. No business combination terms, board recommendation, advisor, or deal economics were disclosed. Watch vote outcome and redemption levels as the extension/combination clock runs.
